description:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 
 This position reports to: 
Systems Manager - SIOP - Business Intelligence 
 __
 The work model for the role is: Onsite #LI-Onsite

 Your role and responsibilities: 
 The Operations Data Specialist, within the MONM Business IS/Digital Tools & Technology organization, serves as the bridge between business processes and technology, enabling Operations and cross-functional teams to make faster, more informed decisions through trusted data, integrated systems, and scalable analytics solutions. Working across SIOP, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Logistics, Quality, Finance, and related functions, the role drives process efficiency, data quality, system integration, reporting, and analytical capabilities while advancing automation, advanced analytics, AI/ML, and emerging digital technologies. The position ensures that digital solutions deliver measurable business value and operate within a secure, governed, and sustainable technology environment.
 
 10 Core Steps: Understand the Business Process → Define the Information → Engineer the Data → Govern & Secure It → Build the Solution → Apply Analytics & AI → Validate & Operate It → Enable the User → Improve the Business → Delight the Customer 
 
 Our Team Dynamics 
 Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there. 
 
 
 You will be mainly accountable for: 
 Partner with business stakeholders and global teams to translate operational, planning, reporting, analytics, and data requirements into scalable digital, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions that improve business performance.
 Design, develop, and support trusted data products, integrations, applications, and analytics solutions by modeling, transforming, governing, and securing enterprise data across business systems to enable reliable decision-making and operational excellence.
 Drive process improvement through standardization, automation, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI capabilities, ensuring solutions are accurate, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business value.
 Ensure solution quality, performance, governance, and sustainability through architecture standards, testing, monitoring, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous adoption of emerging data, analytics, and digital technologies.
 
 Qualifications for the role: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field with 6+ years of experience developing and supporting data, analytics, reporting, and business intelligence solutions, including data extraction, integration, transformation, modeling, and analysis across enterprise systems.
 Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, communicate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, and independently manage priorities, problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration.
 Preferred Experience Includes: 
 Strong expertise in data management and architecture, including SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT, cloud data platforms, governance, lineage, data quality, security, and performance optimization of enterprise data solutions.
 Hands-on experience with modern analytics and digital technologies, including Power BI, Snowflake, DAX, Power Query, Python, AI/ML, enterprise AI, application development, DevOps, Industry 4.0 solutions, and Microsoft 365.
 Deep knowledge of SAP ERP and integrated supply chain, operations, and planning processes, including MM, PP, SD, QM, PM, EHS, SIOP/S&OP/IBP, demand and supply planning, inventory management, production, logistics, capacity planning, and order fulfillment.
 Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.
 
 More about us: 
 ABB’s NEMA Motors Division is the global leading electric NEMA motors manufacturer. With more than 4,500 employees across the globe and seven manufacturing locations that produce more than 1.6 million motors every year, the division powers its customers from many industries with safe, reliable energy-efficient and effective solutions. NEMA Motors Division is a trusted leader with the shortest lead time and the broadest modularized product offering.
 
 What's in it for you 
 We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.
 
 ABB is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer for protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities at ABB.
 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their- sex (gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation), marital status, citizenship, age, race and ethnicity, inclusive of traits historically associated with race or ethnicity, including but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles, color, religious creed, national origin, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, genetic information, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal and state law.
 
 For more information regarding your (EEO) rights as an applicant, please visit the following websites: https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf

EST Monday through Friday by contacting an ABB HR Representative at 1-888-694-7762.
 
 Protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access ABB's career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by calling an ABB HR Representative at 1-888-694-7762 or by sending an email to US-AskHR@abb.com . Resumes and applications will not be accepted in this manner.
 
 ABB Benefit Summary for eligible US employees 
 [excludes ABB E-mobility, Athens union, Puerto Rico]
 Go to MyBenefitsABB.com and click on “Candidate/Guest” to learn more
 
 Health, Life & Disability 
 Choice between two medical plan options: A PPO plan called the Copay Plan OR a High Deductible Health Plan (with a Health Savings Account) called the High Deductible Plan. 
 Choice between two dental plan options: Core and Core Plus
 Vision benefit
 Company paid life insurance (2X base pay)
 Company paid AD&D (1X base pay)

 Short Term Disability – up to 26 weeks – Company paid
 Long Term Disability – 60% of pay – Company paid. Ability to “buy-up” to 66 2/3% of pay.
 Supplemental benefits – 100% employee paid (Accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, pet insurance
 Paid Parental Leave
 Employee Assistance Program
 Health Advocate support resources for mental/behavioral health, general health navigation and virtual health, and infertility/adoption
 Employee discount program
 
 Retirement 
 401k Savings Plan with Company Contributions 
 Employee Stock Acquisition Plan (ESAP)
 
 Time off 
 ABB provides 11 paid holidays. Salaried exempt positions are provided vacation under a permissive time away policy.
